title: AnalyticalResult
description: A derived analytical output produced from measurement evidence: an Estimate, Forecast, Simulation Result, or Recommendation (CR-MET-012 section 7, Q20b-prime). Deliberately EXCLUDES Observation (dea:MeasurementObservation, CR-MET-001) and Decision (dea:Decision, CR-4 section 13): both already exist as first-class entities with their own lifecycle. Absorbing them as result_type values would destroy identity and would conflate a derived analytical artifact with an authorized management choice. The 4 result types share a common provenance, quality, and confidence model; the result_type discriminator preserves the user-supplied section 7 distinction. An AnalyticalResult MUST NOT publish as an equivalent measurement fact to an Observation. The metamodel provides the semantic foundation; analytical engines, forecasting platforms, and workflow orchestration systems provide the runtime.

result_type.description: CR-MET-012 section 7 (Q20b-prime). observation is NOT a member: dea:MeasurementObservation is the first-class Observation. decision is NOT a member: dea:Decision is the first-class authorized management choice. The user-supplied section 7 requirement that these MUST NOT be conflated or published as equivalent measurement facts is enforced structurally.

analytical_capability.description: CR-MET-012 section 3: the 6 complementary analytical capabilities. descriptive answers what happened; diagnostic answers why; predictive answers what is likely; prescriptive answers what should we do; comparative answers how do we compare; scenario_simulation answers what would happen if.

subject_ref.description: The subject the analytical result speaks about (a Metric, MeasurementObservation, or other measurable entity).

value.description: The analytical output value, when the result type produces a value. Null for a recommendation that proposes an action rather than a quantity.

reporting_period_ref.description: The dea:ReportingPeriod the result speaks about (CR-MET-011).

horizon_ref.description: The forward-looking dea:ReportingPeriod a forecast or simulation result projects onto. REQUIRED for forecast and simulation_result; MUST be null otherwise.

evidence_refs.description: The measurement evidence (dea:MeasurementObservation) the result was derived from. An AnalyticalResult MUST cite its evidence; an unsupported analytical output is not admissible.

provenance_reference.description: Reference to the dea:Provenance record (CR-MET-011 section 5) describing how this result came to exist.

confidence.description: Declared confidence in the analytical output. REQUIRED for every result type; an unquantified analytical output is not admissible.

uncertainty.description: Explicit uncertainty statement. REQUIRED for forecast and simulation_result, which are inherently uncertain; optional otherwise.

model_ref.description: The analytical model or AIML model that produced the result. REQUIRED for forecast and simulation_result.

scenario_ref.description: The dea:Scenario a simulation_result or scenario-dependent recommendation is conditioned on. REQUIRED for simulation_result; MUST be null otherwise.

aggregation_rule_ref.description: CR-MET-012 Q21a: the dea:AggregationRule applied. Aggregation MUST respect the CR-MET-005 rules: a simple arithmetic average is NOT a universal aggregation method; ratios MUST NOT be summed; ratios MUST NOT be naively averaged; weighted means MUST declare explicit weights.

alternative_considered.description: Prescriptive results SHOULD record the alternatives considered, so the recommendation is auditable rather than opaque.

responsible_party_ref.description: The accountable party for the analytical result (W3C PROV responsible-party concept; CR-MET-011 section 5).
